title: What an outlier changes
statement:
In the data 5, 6, 6, 8, 12 the largest value 12 is replaced by 1200. Which statement is true?

[_]{a}

choices: Both the mean and the median increase a lot
The mean increases a lot; the median stays 6
The median increases; the mean stays the same
Neither changes, because only one value changed
explanations: The median is still the middle value, 6.
The mean uses every value's size, so it jumps.

hints: Which statistic uses the size of every value?
Which one only uses the middle position?
The middle value of 5, 6, 6, 8, 1200 is still 6.
solution: The mean jumps to 245; the median is the middle of the sorted values, still 6.
